role_agent_name: Campus facilities and energy operations lead (FMGT)
abstract: Maintains autonomous emergency fuel inventory logs and monitored peak critical clinical electrical load baselines
system_message:
You are Campus facilities and energy operations lead (FMGT). The Campus facilities and energy operations lead (FMGT) maintains autonomous emergency fuel inventory logs, monitored peak critical clinical electrical load baselines, and central chilled water plant seasonal operational data for the hospital campus.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Chilled water plant seasonal efficiency（CHIL）
information_points.content:
FMGT-CHIL-GY9：For the Reciprocating natural gas and bio-methane cogeneration scheme, central chiller plant audits indicate that the surgical suite and intensive care cooling loop exhibits a chilled water coefficient of performance of 4.2 during peak cooling demand.
FMGT-CHIL-CL9：For the Dual-fuel lean-burn microturbine and thermal recovery scheme, central chiller plant measurements show that the surgical suite and intensive care cooling loop operates with a chilled water coefficient of performance of 5.1 during peak cooling demand.
FMGT-CHIL-PKB：For the Containerized lithium-iron-phosphate battery and diesel rotary UPS scheme, the central chiller plant cooling loop for the surgical suite and intensive care areas demonstrates a chilled water coefficient of performance of 4.6 during peak cooling demand.

information_points.title: Maintains autonomous emergency fuel inventory logs and monitored peak critical clinical electrical load baselines（CAMP）
information_points.content:
FMGT-CAMP-KZ3：For the Reciprocating natural gas and bio-methane cogeneration scheme, dedicated campus on-site fuel tanks and contracted continuous pipeline storage provide an autonomous emergency fuel run duration of 120 h of continuous islanded operation at peak critical clinical load without external resupply, while hospital critical branch circuits register a peak critical clinical demand of 3100 kW.
FMGT-CAMP-K5F：For the Containerized lithium-iron-phosphate battery and diesel rotary UPS scheme, dedicated campus on-site fuel storage supports an autonomous emergency fuel run duration of 72 h of continuous islanded operation at peak critical clinical load without external resupply, alongside a peak critical clinical demand across critical branch circuits of 2800 kW.
FMGT-CAMP-34W：For the Dual-fuel lean-burn microturbine and thermal recovery scheme, dedicated campus on-site fuel tanks and contracted continuous pipeline storage deliver an autonomous emergency fuel run duration of 48 h of continuous islanded operation at peak critical clinical load without external resupply, with hospital critical branch circuits recording a peak critical clinical demand of 3400 kW.
